verses.text: <pb/><t>Ƙafafunki suna da kyau da takalmi,</t> <t>Ke mafificiyar budurwa!</t> <t>Tsarin cinyoyinki kamar aikin gwanin sassaƙa ne.</t>
<t>Cibinki kamar finjali ne, wanda bai taɓa rasa gaurayayyen ruwan inabi a ciki ba.</t> <t>Kwankwasonki kamar damin alkama ne a tsakiyar bi-rana.</t>
<t>Mamanki kamar bareyi biyu ne, wato tagwayen barewa ne.</t>

<t>Wuyanki kamar hasumiyar hauren giwa ne.</t> <t>Idonki kamar tafki ne cikin birnin Heshbon,</t> <t>Kusa da ƙofar Bat-rabbim.</t> <t>Hancinki kyakkyawa ne kamar hasumiyar Lebanon ta tsaron Dimashƙu.</t>
<t>Kin ɗaga kanki sama kamar Dutsen Karmel.</t> <t>Kitsattsen gashin kanki kamar shunayya mafi kyau ne,</t> <t>Yakan kama hankalin sarki.</t>
<t>Ke kyakkyawa ce ƙaunatacciyata,</t> <t>Kina sa ni jin daɗi a rai.</t>
<t>Kina da kyan gani kamar itacen dabino,</t> <t>Mamanki kamar nonnan dabino.</t>
<t>Zan hau itacen dabino in tsinko 'ya'yan.</t> <t>Mamanki kamar nonnan inabi suke a gare ni.</t> <t>Numfashinki kamar ƙanshin gawasa ne.</t>
<t>Bakinki kamar ruwan inabi mafi kyau ne. <pb/>Idan haka ne bari ya bulbulo sosai zuwa ga ƙaunataccena,</t> <t>Ya gangara leɓunan masu barci. <pb/></t>
<t>Zo saurayina, bari mu tafi waje,</t> <t>Mu kwana a karkara.</t>

<t>Za mu tashi da sassafe, mu duba kurangun inabi,</t> <t>Mu ga ko sun fara tohowa,</t> <t>Ko furanni sun fara buɗewa.</t> <t>Mu ga ko itatuwan rumman sun yi fure.</t> <t>A can zan bayyana maka ƙaunata.</t>
<t>Za ka ji ƙanshin shuke-shuke</t> <t>Da na dukan 'ya'yan itatuwa masu daɗi.</t> <t>Na adana maka jin daɗi na dā da na yanzu, ya ƙaunataccena.</t>
